evidence: AIST (National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology)

evidence: KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)
cells.rationale: South Korea is a global leader in memory and foundry manufacturing, with Samsung and SK Hynix at the forefront of process technology. This drives a very high demand for advanced fab equipment and lithography expertise, supported by a strong domestic ecosystem and R&D.

evidence: Carl Zeiss SMT (optics for ASML EUV)

evidence: TNO (Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research)
